personality.description: This person tends to stick to familiar routines, prefers proven methods, and is cautious about adopting unfamiliar ideas. They are highly organized and careful, often planning ahead, paying close attention to details, and following through consistently. When faced with moral dilemmas, they usually respond calmly and try to find a fair, practical solution that minimizes conflict and protects group harmony. In discussions, they speak quietly and thoughtfully, prefer small-group exchanges, and choose their words carefully to be considerate and precise.
traits: has assertively moved up the ranks into positions of leadership
prioritizes having control and authority over others
makes quick and definitive decisions, and once a decision is made it is usually final
has their own views of how tasks should be accomplished
uses reward and punishment to get people to follow their ideas
